Class BoardInitiator

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.ui.BoardInitiator
public class BoardInitiator extends Object
Handles the initial setup and layering of the game board's visual components.

This class is responsible for:

  • Creating the StackPane structure that allows the "Ghost" piece and Active piece to float transparently over the static background grid.
  • Instantiating the pools of Rectangle objects used for rendering.
  • Setting up the layout for the "Next Brick" preview window.
This is effectively a "Factory" class for the BoardVisuals object.

    • setupLayers

      public javafx.scene.layout.GridPane setupLayers(javafx.scene.layout.GridPane gamePanel, javafx.scene.layout.GridPane brickPanel)
      Configures the Z-ordering (layering) of the game panels.

      Tetris requires three distinct layers to render correctly:

      1. Bottom: The gamePanel (Static, locked blocks).
      2. Middle: The ghostPanel (The shadow indicating where the piece will land).
      3. Top: The brickPanel (The currently falling active piece).
      This method creates a StackPane to hold these layers on top of each other and injects it into the main layout container.
      Parameters:
      gamePanel - The GridPane containing the static background blocks.
      brickPanel - The GridPane containing the active moving block.
      Returns:
      The newly created ghostPanel, which needs to be passed to the initialization logic.

    • initBoard

      public BoardVisuals initBoard(javafx.scene.layout.GridPane gamePanel, javafx.scene.layout.GridPane ghostPanel, javafx.scene.layout.GridPane brickPanel, javafx.scene.layout.Pane nextBrickPane, int[][] boardMatrix, ViewData brick)
      Instantiates the grid of Rectangle objects for the board, ghost, and active pieces.

      This method fills the empty GridPanes with JavaFX Rectangles.
      Note on Hidden Rows: Standard Tetris boards have 2-4 hidden rows at the top where pieces spawn. This loop starts at i = 2, effectively hiding the top two rows from the visual grid while keeping them in the logical matrix.

      Parameters:
      gamePanel - The pane for static blocks.
      ghostPanel - The pane for the ghost piece.
      brickPanel - The pane for the active piece.
      nextBrickPane - The pane for the "Next Piece" sidebar.
      boardMatrix - The logical data source (used to determine dimensions).
      brick - The current brick data (used to determine 4x4 or 3x3 grid size).
      Returns:
      A BoardVisuals record containing references to all created Rectangles.

    • initNextBrickGrids

      private List<javafx.scene.shape.Rectangle[][]> initNextBrickGrids(javafx.scene.layout.Pane nextBrickPane)
      Initialises the "Next Brick" preview area.

      It creates 3 separate 4x4 grids of rectangles, spaced out horizontally in the preview pane.

      Parameters:
      nextBrickPane - The UI container for the sidebar preview.
      Returns:
      A list of the 3 grids (each grid is a 4x4 array of Rectangles).
